_about: DocuBharat evaluation set: 40 cases over the 7 synthetic sample documents (data/sample_documents). Ground truth was written from the documents' source text in scripts/make_sample_documents.py; tests/test_evaluation.py checks that every support_text occurs in its document. QA 'must' is a list of groups; every group must be matched by at least one of its alternatives (dates are compared as calendar dates, other values after removing commas, spaces and case).
